info.name: Ice Bank API
info.description:
Requests for every area of the Ice Bank API (local build).

**Start here:** select the **Ice Bank - local** environment, then send the three requests in **1. Sign in** in order.
They save `accessToken`, and every other request uses it automatically (collection Authorization = Bearer `{{accessToken}}`).

- Access tokens last 15 minutes: send **Refresh tokens** (or sign in again).
- **Admin (teller)** has its own sign-in requests and uses `{{adminToken}}`.
- **0. Test support → Reset** restores the seed data (and ends every session, so sign in again afterwards).
- Money-moving POSTs send `Idempotency-Key: {{$guid}}`, a new value each time. Set a fixed value to try a replay.

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (or `npx newman run`) for a quick smoke test.

item.name: 0. Test support
item.description: Health, reset and the sandbox clock. These use the `X-Sandbox-Key` header, not a token.

request.description: Deletes everything in your sandbox and re-seeds it: same ids, same balances, clock back to 2026-11-02 09:00 Toronto.

item.name: 1. Sign in
item.description: Send these three in order. Change `email` in the environment to sign in as another persona (password is always IceBank#2026).

request.description: Step 1 of 3. Checks the password and sends a 6-digit code to Ice Mail. Saves `mfaToken`.

item.name: 2. Read the code from Ice Mail

request.description: Step 2 of 3. Reads the newest one-time code with the sandbox key, the way an automated test does. Saves `otpCode`.

exec: pm.test("an OTP message exists", () => pm.expect(m && m.otpCode).to.match(/^\d{6}$/));

request.description: Step 3 of 3. Returns a 15-minute access token and a 7-day refresh token. Saves them as `accessToken` and `refreshToken`.
Swaps the refresh token for new tokens. The old refresh token stops working (rotation).

exec: pm.test("Emma has 4 accounts after a reset", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.at.least(1));
